v2.88.2 已构建、完成镜像内增量回归并推送。以下命令用于复现构建与验证：
```{bash}
sudo docker login dockerhub.genostack.com

sudo docker build -f Dockerfile \
  -t dockerhub.genostack.com/sanshu/metage:v2.88.2 .

# 验证镜像：
sudo docker image inspect \
  dockerhub.genostack.com/sanshu/metage:v2.88.2 \
  --format 'ID={{.Id}} Created={{.Created}} Digests={{json .RepoDigests}}'

# 再检查脚本和字体：
sudo docker run --rm \
  dockerhub.genostack.com/sanshu/metage:v2.88.2 \
  bash -lc '
    test -f /root/microbiome/microbiome/metage_v2.88.2/dealdata_update.py
    test -f /root/microbiome/microbiome/metage_v2.88.2/choose_plot_style.py
    test -f /root/microbiome/microbiome/metage_v2.88.2/plot_theme_update.R
    conda run -n py39 python -c "import Bio, matplotlib, numpy, openpyxl, pandas"
    fc-match "Times New Roman"
    fc-match "Arial"
    fc-match "SimSun"
    echo "v2.88.2 verification passed"
  '

sudo docker push dockerhub.genostack.com/sanshu/metage:v2.88.2

```

本次正式生产镜像已固定为：

```text
dockerhub.genostack.com/sanshu/metage@sha256:5264730802751d591f1a6f25878597377778493d3a396b5ee324475004e60adf
```
